```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# GFW-facing comparison of the two pulls of the same AOI and window: the
# 2026-10-06 pull (pipeline v4, via ":latest") and the 2026-10-28 pinned pull
# (":v5.0"). Decision D-068; design in planning/gfw_pipeline_v5_plan.qmd,
# Section 4. Reads the raw pulls and the hand-made decision files in
# references/ (read only); writes its tables to reports/pipeline_compare/tables/
# (gitignored: derived GFW products). Nothing in data/ or references/ is
# written.
#
# Render from the repo root:
#   quarto render reports/pipeline_compare/gfw_v4_v5_comparison.qmd
#
# Code is hidden (echo: false) because the readers are Global Fishing Watch
# staff, not this project's analysts; the code is in the repository.

# run from the repo root (the folder holding renv.lock) so the relative paths
# in r/paths.R resolve however the qmd is run
root <- getwd()
while (!file.exists(file.path(root, "renv.lock")) && dirname(root) != root) root <- dirname(root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(knitr)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")   # lease_distance(), dist_band_of()
source("r/compare_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters; run chunk by chunk, `params` may be missing, so fall back
# to the header defaults
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else list(old = "v4", new = "v5")
p_old <- make_gfw_paths(qparams$old)
p_new <- make_gfw_paths(qparams$new)
v_old <- qparams$old
v_new <- qparams$new

tab_dir <- file.path(p_old$compare, "tables")
fig_dir <- file.path(p_old$compare, "figures")
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Display helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

# number formatting for prose and tables
n0  <- \(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
p1  <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
sp1 <- \(x) sprintf("%+.1f%%", x)

# a kable with thousands separators; `digits` applies to every numeric column
kt <- function(d, digits = 0, ...) {
  kable(d, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)
}

# Writes `d` to tables/ and returns an HTML link that downloads the same CSV
# from inside this self-contained page, so the vessel lists travel with the
# report when it is e-mailed
csv_link <- function(d, file, label = paste0("Download ", file)) {
  path <- file.path(tab_dir, file)
  write_csv(d, path, na = "")
  b64 <- base64enc::base64encode(path)
  asis_output(sprintf('<p><a download="%s" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s">&#8595; %s</a> (%s rows)</p>',
                      file, b64, label, n0(nrow(d))))
}

# Colours (dataviz reference palette): the two versions take categorical
# slots 1 and 2, every chart the same way round; diverging maps use the
# blue <-> red pair around a neutral grey
col_ver <- setNames(c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"), c(v_old, v_new))
col_loss <- "#e34948"; col_gain <- "#2a78d6"; col_mid <- "#f0efec"

theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#e6e5e1", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#52514e", hjust = 0))
```

```{r read, include=FALSE}
# Both pulls, trimmed to the analysis window (2016-01-01 to 2026-08-31, the
# last day the Ørsted survey-date files cover). Every comparison below is
# inside the window, so the stages are defined for every record.
pull_old <- read_chr(p_old$pull_info)
pull_new <- read_chr(p_new$pull_info)

vp_old  <- read_gfw(p_old$raw_vp)  |> in_analysis_window()
afe_old <- read_gfw(p_old$raw_afe) |> in_analysis_window()
vp_new  <- read_gfw(p_new$raw_vp)  |> in_analysis_window() |>
  mutate(speed = as.numeric(Speed))   # new in v5: mean speed (kn) of the vessel-cell-day
afe_new <- read_gfw(p_new$raw_afe) |> in_analysis_window()

# The hand-made review (v4 crosswalk: removal list + Ørsted survey dates +
# accepted decisions), the decisions themselves, gear corrections and GARFO
# permit groups. All were made against the v4 labels.
cw_chr    <- read_chr(p_old$crosswalk)
decisions <- read_chr(p_old$decisions)
gear_in   <- read_chr(p_old$gear)
permits   <- read_chr(p_old$permit_groups) |> select(MMSI, permit_group)
removals  <- read_chr(p_old$removals)

# Source labels as shown to GFW. The files record a personal e-mail from an
# Ørsted contact as a source; the report names the contract and the PSO
# report instead (the user, 2026-10-29). Display only: Identified_By feeds no
# classification, and the reference files are unchanged.
source_label <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace("Anna Turano \\(Orsted\\) email; (SFW PSO PAM Report 2024 Appendix A)", "\\1") |>
    str_replace("^Anna Turano \\(Orsted\\) email$", "Ørsted–SSNA safety-vessel contract") |>
    str_replace("^orsted_survey_dates$|^orsted_fv_survey_dates_aug2026\\.csv$",
                "Ørsted survey project and date data")
}
cw_chr    <- mutate(cw_chr, Identified_By = source_label(Identified_By))
decisions <- mutate(decisions, Identified_By = source_label(Identified_By))
removals  <- mutate(removals, Identified_By = source_label(Identified_By))
roster    <- read_chr(sprintf(p_old$roster, v_old))
```

```{r cells, include=FALSE}
# Signed distance from each cell centroid to the nearest lease boundary and
# its BAG distance band, for every cell in either pull (v5 has cells v4 lacks
# and vice versa, D-067). GFW's Lat/Lon mark a cell's lower-left corner.
crs_utm <- 32619
leases <- map_dfr(p_old$leases, \(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  mutate(project = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))

cells <- bind_rows(vp_old, vp_new, afe_old, afe_new) |>
  distinct(cell_id, ix, iy) |>
  mutate(lon = (ix + 0.5) * 0.01, lat = (iy + 0.5) * 0.01)
cell_pts <- st_as_sf(cells, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm)
cells <- bind_cols(cells, lease_distance(cell_pts, leases)) |>
  mutate(dist_band = if_else(dist_lease_km <= 15,
                             as.character(dist_band_of(pmin(dist_lease_km, 15))),
                             ">15"),
         dist_band = factor(dist_band, levels = c("inside", "0-2", "2-4", "4-8", "8-15", ">15")))
```

```{r reconcile, include=FALSE}
# Section 2: do the two pulls line up? Totals per version, then the share of
# hours that sits on keys both versions share, at three grains.
totals <- function(d, ds, ver) {
  tibble(dataset = ds, version = ver, records = nrow(d),
         mmsi = n_distinct(d$MMSI), vessel_ids = n_distinct(d$`Vessel ID`),
         cells = n_distinct(d$cell_id), hours = sum(d$hours))
}
tot <- bind_rows(totals(vp_old, "VP", v_old), totals(vp_new, "VP", v_new),
                 totals(afe_old, "AFE", v_old), totals(afe_new, "AFE", v_new))
tot_wide <- tot |>
  pivot_longer(records:hours, names_to = "measure") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version) |>
  mutate(change = .data[[v_new]] - .data[[v_old]],
         pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))
tv <- \(ds, m, v) tot_wide |> filter(dataset == ds, measure == m) |> pull(all_of(v))

grains <- list(
  "Record (Vessel ID × cell × day)" = c("Vessel ID", "cell_id", "date"),
  "Vessel-day (Vessel ID × day)"    = c("Vessel ID", "date"),
  "Cell total (whole window)"       = "cell_id")
joins <- list(VP = list(vp_old, vp_new), AFE = list(afe_old, afe_new))

grain_tab <- imap_dfr(joins, \(pair, ds) imap_dfr(grains, \(key, g) {
  s <- summarise_join(join_versions(pair[[1]], pair[[2]], key))
  tibble(dataset = ds, grain = g,
         keys_old = sum(s$keys[s$status != "new_only"]),
         keys_new = sum(s$keys[s$status != "old_only"]),
         pct_old_matched = 100 - s$pct_h_old[s$status == "old_only"],
         pct_new_matched = 100 - s$pct_h_new[s$status == "new_only"],
         pct_old_same    = s$pct_h_old[s$status == "same"])
}))

# VP: unmatched records within a matched vessel-day. Chebyshev distance (in
# cells) from each old-only record to the nearest new-only record of the same
# vessel-day: a systematic lattice shift would put most at distance 1 in one
# direction; track resampling spreads them out and in every direction.
vp_rec <- join_versions(vp_old, vp_new, grains[[1]])
only_old <- vp_rec |> filter(status == "old_only") |>
  left_join(distinct(cells, cell_id, ix, iy), by = "cell_id") |> mutate(r = row_number())
only_new <- vp_rec |> filter(status == "new_only") |>
  left_join(distinct(cells, cell_id, ix, iy), by = "cell_id")
offsets <- inner_join(select(only_old, r, `Vessel ID`, date, ix, iy),
                      select(only_new, `Vessel ID`, date, ix2 = ix, iy2 = iy),
                      by = c("Vessel ID", "date"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(d = pmax(abs(ix2 - ix), abs(iy2 - iy))) |>
  group_by(r) |> slice_min(d, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup()
offset_tab <- offsets |>
  mutate(cells_apart = cut(d, c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, Inf), right = TRUE,
                           labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4-5", "6-10", ">10"))) |>
  count(cells_apart) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))
pct_rec_with_partner <- 100 * nrow(offsets) / nrow(only_old)

# Cell totals agree? Pearson r of per-cell hours (all vessels) across versions
cell_r <- map_dbl(joins, \(pair) {
  j <- join_versions(pair[[1]], pair[[2]], "cell_id") |>
    mutate(across(c(h_old, h_new), \(x) coalesce(x, 0)))
  cor(j$h_old, j$h_new)
})

# Hours by year, both datasets, both versions (figure 1)
by_year <- bind_rows(
  vp_old  |> mutate(dataset = "VP",  version = v_old),
  vp_new  |> mutate(dataset = "VP",  version = v_new),
  afe_old |> mutate(dataset = "AFE", version = v_old),
  afe_new |> mutate(dataset = "AFE", version = v_new)) |>
  mutate(year = year(date)) |>
  group_by(dataset, version, year) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r labels, include=FALSE}
# Section 3: vessel type and gear relabelling, one row per MMSI
mt <- mmsi_transitions(vp_old, afe_old, vp_new, afe_new) |>
  left_join(permits, by = "MMSI") |>
  left_join(bind_rows(vp_old, afe_old, vp_new, afe_new) |>
              filter(!is.na(`Vessel Name`)) |>
              count(MMSI, `Vessel Name`) |>
              slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, by = MMSI) |>
              select(MMSI, Vessel_Name = `Vessel Name`), by = "MMSI")

type_tr <- transition_table(mt, "type_old", "type_new", "vp_old") |>
  left_join(transition_table(mt, "type_old", "type_new", "afe_old") |>
              select(from, to, afe_hours = hours), by = c("from", "to")) |>
  rename(vp_hours = hours, pct_vp_of_from = pct_of_from)

# vessel types each version uses, by MMSI and VP hours
type_sets <- bind_rows(
  vp_old |> mutate(version = v_old), vp_new |> mutate(version = v_new)) |>
  group_by(version, type = `Vessel Type`) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), vp_hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = c(mmsi, vp_hours), values_fill = 0)

# fishing <-> non-fishing flips
flips <- mt |>
  filter(!is.na(type_old), !is.na(type_new), fishing_old != fishing_new) |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(fishing_old, "FISHING -> non-fishing", "non-fishing -> FISHING"))
flip_tab <- flips |>
  group_by(direction, type_new = if_else(fishing_old, type_new, type_old)) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), vp_old = sum(vp_old), afe_old = sum(afe_old),
            vp_new = sum(vp_new), afe_new = sum(afe_new),
            with_garfo_permit = sum(!is.na(permit_group)), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(direction, desc(mmsi))

# v4-FISHING vessels v5 no longer types FISHING that hold a GARFO commercial
# or for-hire permit: the permit is independent evidence they fish, so these
# are candidate new v5 false negatives (not yet hand-checked; see caveats)
lost_fishing <- flips |>
  filter(direction == "FISHING -> non-fishing") |>
  select(MMSI, Vessel_Name, type_old, gear_old, type_new, gear_new, permit_group,
         vp_old, vp_new, afe_old, afe_new) |>
  arrange(desc(afe_old), desc(vp_old))
# whether the hand review covers each one (hull class and the source of the
# decision); joined after the truth chunk builds the reviewed set, below

# INSUFFICIENT_DATA: where those vessels came from
insuff <- mt |> filter(type_new %in% "INSUFFICIENT_DATA")
insuff_tab <- insuff |>
  group_by(type_old = coalesce(type_old, "(absent)")) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), vp_new = sum(vp_new), afe_old = sum(afe_old), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mmsi))

# Gear: codes and analysis classes, among MMSIs typed FISHING in both
both_fishing <- mt |> filter(fishing_old, fishing_new)
gear_tr <- transition_table(both_fishing, "gear_old", "gear_new", "afe_old") |>
  left_join(transition_table(both_fishing, "gear_old", "gear_new", "vp_old") |>
              select(from, to, vp_hours = hours), by = c("from", "to")) |>
  rename(afe_hours = hours, pct_afe_of_from = pct_of_from)
class_tr <- both_fishing |>
  group_by(class_old, class_new) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), vp_old = sum(vp_old), afe_old = sum(afe_old), .groups = "drop")
gear_sets <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(vp_old, afe_old) |> mutate(version = v_old),
  bind_rows(vp_new, afe_new) |> mutate(version = v_new)) |>
  filter(`Vessel Type` == "FISHING") |>
  group_by(version, gear = `Gear Type`) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = mmsi, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(desc(.data[[v_old]] + .data[[v_new]]))
```

```{r truth, include=FALSE}
# Section 5: score both versions against the project's hand review.
# hull_truth(): crosswalk hull classes + rejected decisions (GFW label
# confirmed). gear_truth(): accepted gear corrections + confirmed GFW gear.
ht <- hull_truth(cw_chr, decisions) |>
  left_join(select(mt, MMSI, type_old, type_new, gear_old, gear_new,
                   vp_old, vp_new, afe_old, afe_new, Vessel_Name_gfw = Vessel_Name),
            by = "MMSI") |>
  mutate(Vessel_Name = coalesce(Vessel_Name, Vessel_Name_gfw), .keep = "unused") |>
  mutate(out_old = hull_outcome(truth_fishing, type_old),
         out_new = hull_outcome(truth_fishing, type_new),
         status  = error_status(out_old, out_new)) |>
  filter(out_old != "absent" | out_new != "absent")   # reviewed, but no records in the window

# confusion counts and hour-weighted shares per version
confusion <- bind_rows(
  ht |> transmute(version = v_old, outcome = out_old, vp = vp_old, afe = afe_old),
  ht |> transmute(version = v_new, outcome = out_new, vp = vp_new, afe = afe_new)) |>
  filter(outcome != "absent") |>
  group_by(version, outcome) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), vp_hours = sum(vp), afe_hours = sum(afe), .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(version, outcome = c("TP", "FP", "FN", "TN"), fill = list(mmsi = 0, vp_hours = 0, afe_hours = 0))
rates <- confusion |>
  select(version, outcome, mmsi) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = mmsi) |>
  mutate(precision = 100 * TP / (TP + FP), recall = 100 * TP / (TP + FN))

hull_cols <- c("MMSI", "Vessel_Name", "truth_hull", "Identified_By", "evidence_ref",
               "type_old", "type_new", "gear_old", "gear_new", "status",
               "vp_old", "vp_new", "afe_old", "afe_new", "Notes")
fp_old <- ht |> filter(out_old == "FP") |> select(all_of(hull_cols)) |> arrange(status, desc(vp_old))
fn_old <- ht |> filter(out_old == "FN") |> select(all_of(hull_cols)) |> arrange(status, desc(vp_old))
new_err <- ht |> filter(status == "new error") |> select(all_of(hull_cols), out_new) |> arrange(desc(vp_old))

# the vessels that left FISHING, with the review's verdict where there is one
# (NA = not reviewed: a candidate error only)
lost_fishing <- lost_fishing |>
  left_join(transmute(ht, MMSI, reviewed_as = truth_hull, review_source = Identified_By,
                      charter = str_to_title(na_if(Operation, ""))), by = "MMSI") |>
  relocate(reviewed_as, review_source, charter, .after = permit_group)
status_tab <- function(d) d |>
  group_by(status) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), vp_old = sum(vp_old), vp_new = sum(vp_new),
            afe_old = sum(afe_old), afe_new = sum(afe_new), .groups = "drop")
# display names for a status_tab() table
rename_status <- \(d) rename(d, `Status in v5` = status, MMSIs = mmsi,
                             `VP h v4` = vp_old, `VP h v5` = vp_new,
                             `AFE h v4` = afe_old, `AFE h v5` = afe_new)

# Gear: reference class vs each version's GFW gear
gt_ <- gear_truth(gear_in) |>
  left_join(select(mt, MMSI, type_old, type_new, gear_old, gear_new, vp_old, vp_new, afe_old, afe_new),
            by = "MMSI") |>
  mutate(gout_old = gear_outcome(truth_gear, gear_old),
         gout_new = gear_outcome(truth_gear, gear_new)) |>
  filter(gout_old != "absent" | gout_new != "absent")
gear_score <- bind_rows(
  gt_ |> transmute(version = v_old, truth_gear, outcome = gout_old, afe = afe_old),
  gt_ |> transmute(version = v_new, truth_gear, outcome = gout_new, afe = afe_new)) |>
  group_by(truth_gear, version, outcome) |>
  summarise(mmsi = n(), afe_hours = sum(afe), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = c(mmsi, afe_hours), values_fill = 0)
gear_move <- gt_ |>
  count(truth_gear, gout_old, gout_new, name = "mmsi") |>
  arrange(truth_gear, desc(mmsi))
gear_cols <- c("MMSI", "Vessel_Name", "truth_gear", "basis", "gear_old", "gear_new",
               "gout_old", "gout_new", "vp_old", "vp_new", "afe_old", "afe_new")

# The cohort's gear class, held fixed across versions so that model and label
# effects are not confused: the reference class where reviewed, else the old
# version's GFW class, else the new one's
mmsi_gear <- mt |>
  left_join(select(gt_, MMSI, truth_gear), by = "MMSI") |>
  transmute(MMSI, cohort_gear = coalesce(truth_gear, class_old, class_new))
```

```{r activity, include=FALSE}
# Activity-level false positives: AFE hours GFW gave fishing hulls while they
# were doing verified non-fishing work (Ørsted survey trips, safety/guard
# charters, other operator-confirmed windows). classify() with the v4
# crosswalk flags those records as `excluded` in both versions; it also
# builds the analysis set each version would deliver under this project's
# review (fishing-typed or added hulls, minus non-fishing hulls, gear buoys
# and excluded windows).
cw   <- type_crosswalk(cw_chr, NULL, source = p_old$crosswalk)
gear <- validate_gear(gear_in, source = p_old$gear)

cls <- list(
  vp_old  = classify(vp_old, cw, gear),  vp_new  = classify(vp_new, cw, gear),
  afe_old = classify(afe_old, cw, gear), afe_new = classify(afe_new, cw, gear))

# operation of each crosswalk window, for the excluded records
cw_ops <- cw |> filter(activity_excluded) |>
  transmute(MMSI, w_from = coalesce(valid_from, lo_date), w_to = coalesce(valid_to, hi_date),
            Operation = str_to_title(coalesce(na_if(Operation, ""), "Other")),
            Identified_By)
excl_afe <- function(d, ver) d |>
  filter(excluded) |>
  left_join(cw_ops, by = join_by(MMSI, between(date, w_from, w_to))) |>
  mutate(version = ver)
act <- bind_rows(excl_afe(cls$afe_old, v_old), excl_afe(cls$afe_new, v_new))
act_vp <- bind_rows(excl_afe(cls$vp_old, v_old), excl_afe(cls$vp_new, v_new))

act_tab <- act |>
  group_by(Operation, `Development Stage`, version) |>
  summarise(afe_hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = afe_hours, values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(act_vp |> filter(version == v_new) |>
              group_by(Operation, `Development Stage`) |>
              summarise(vp_hours_new = sum(hours), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("Operation", "Development Stage")) |>
  mutate(pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))

act_vessel <- bind_rows(act, act_vp |> mutate(vp = hours, hours = 0)) |>
  mutate(vp = coalesce(vp, 0)) |>
  group_by(MMSI, Operation, Identified_By, version) |>
  summarise(afe = sum(hours), vp = sum(vp), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = c(afe, vp), values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(select(ht, MMSI, Vessel_Name, type_old, type_new), by = "MMSI") |>
  relocate(Vessel_Name, .after = MMSI) |>
  arrange(desc(.data[[paste0("afe_", v_old)]]))

# Speed check (v5 only has speed). Each AFE record's vessel-day mean speed,
# hours-weighted over the vessel's v5 VP records that day, joined by
# Vessel ID × day (not cell, because cells differ between versions).
vd_speed <- vp_new |>
  filter(!is.na(speed)) |>
  group_by(`Vessel ID`, date) |>
  summarise(speed = weighted.mean(speed, hours), .groups = "drop")
speed_bins <- c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, Inf)
act_set_label <- "survey trip or safety charter"
speed_tab <- bind_rows(cls$afe_old |> mutate(version = v_old),
                       cls$afe_new |> mutate(version = v_new)) |>
  filter(in_primary | excluded) |>
  left_join(vd_speed, by = c("Vessel ID", "date")) |>
  mutate(speed_kn = cut(speed, speed_bins, right = FALSE,
                        labels = c("<2", "2-4", "4-6", "6-8", "8-10", ">=10")),
         speed_kn = fct_na_value_to_level(speed_kn, "no v5 VP that day"),
         set = if_else(excluded, act_set_label, "fishing hulls, other days")) |>
  group_by(set, speed_kn, version) |>
  summarise(afe_hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = afe_hours, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))
```

```{r fixed, include=FALSE}
# Fishing false negatives: AFE hours of reviewed FIXED-gear hulls (lobster
# pots, gillnets; reference class from vessel_gear.csv or confirmed GFW
# gear) outside any verified non-fishing window, v4 vs v5. GFW lists fixed
# gear, pots and traps and set gillnets among v5's known false negatives.
fixed_mmsi <- gt_ |> filter(truth_gear == "FIXED") |> pull(MMSI)
cohort <- function(d, ver) d |>
  filter(!excluded, !nonfish, !is_marker) |>
  left_join(mmsi_gear, by = "MMSI") |>
  mutate(version = ver)
coh_afe <- bind_rows(cohort(cls$afe_old, v_old), cohort(cls$afe_new, v_new))
coh_vp  <- bind_rows(cohort(cls$vp_old, v_old), cohort(cls$vp_new, v_new))

# AFE and the AFE/VP ratio by cohort gear class, both versions; VP is the
# model-free denominator. Only reviewed or GFW-fishing hulls (the analysis set
# of either version) are counted.
gear_ratio <- full_join(
  coh_afe |> filter(in_primary) |> group_by(cohort_gear, version) |>
    summarise(afe = sum(hours), afe_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop"),
  coh_vp |> filter(in_primary) |> group_by(cohort_gear, version) |>
    summarise(vp = sum(hours), vp_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop"),
  by = c("cohort_gear", "version")) |>
  mutate(across(c(afe, vp, afe_mmsi), \(x) coalesce(x, 0)), afe_per_100_vp = 100 * afe / vp)

fixed_vessel <- full_join(
  coh_afe |> filter(MMSI %in% fixed_mmsi) |> group_by(MMSI, version) |>
    summarise(afe = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = afe, names_prefix = "afe_"),
  coh_vp |> filter(MMSI %in% fixed_mmsi) |> group_by(MMSI, version) |>
    summarise(vp = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = vp, names_prefix = "vp_"),
  by = "MMSI") |>
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("afe_", "vp_")), \(x) coalesce(x, 0))) |>
  left_join(select(gt_, MMSI, Vessel_Name, basis, gear_old, gear_new), by = "MMSI") |>
  left_join(select(mt, MMSI, type_old, type_new), by = "MMSI") |>
  relocate(Vessel_Name, type_old, type_new, gear_old, gear_new, .after = MMSI) |>
  arrange(desc(.data[[paste0("afe_", v_old)]]))
fixed_lost <- fixed_vessel |>
  filter(.data[[paste0("afe_", v_old)]] > 0, .data[[paste0("afe_", v_new)]] == 0)

# Month of year (fixed-gear seasonality)
fixed_month <- coh_afe |>
  filter(MMSI %in% fixed_mmsi) |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(month, version) |>
  summarise(afe = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r bias, include=FALSE}
# Section 6: does the change differ by stage or by distance from the leases?
# A change that is uniform cancels out of a Before-After-Gradient contrast;
# one that differs by stage or band does not. Analysis set of each version
# (this project's review applied to each version's labels), cohort gear.
stage_band <- function(d) d |>
  filter(in_primary) |>
  left_join(select(cells, cell_id, dist_band), by = "cell_id") |>
  group_by(version, stage = `Development Stage`, dist_band, cohort_gear) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
sb <- bind_rows(stage_band(coh_vp) |> mutate(dataset = "VP"),
                stage_band(coh_afe) |> mutate(dataset = "AFE"))
ratio_stage <- sb |>
  filter(cohort_gear != "UNRESOLVED") |>
  group_by(dataset, cohort_gear, stage, version) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = hours, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))
ratio_band <- sb |>
  filter(cohort_gear != "UNRESOLVED", dist_band != ">15") |>
  group_by(dataset, cohort_gear, stage, dist_band, version) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = hours, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))

# Per-cell AFE change for the map (analysis set, all gears)
cell_afe <- coh_afe |>
  filter(in_primary) |>
  group_by(cell_id, version) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = hours, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(diff = .data[[v_new]] - .data[[v_old]]) |>
  left_join(cells, by = "cell_id")
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About this report

This report compares two pulls of Global Fishing Watch (GFW) 4Wings data for
the same area and period. The first was made on
`r pull_old$pull_date` from pipeline **`r v_old`**, and the second on
`r pull_new$pull_date` from pipeline **`r v_new`**. The area is the Ørsted
area of interest around the South Fork Wind (SFW), Revolution Wind (RWF) and
Sunrise Wind (SRW) leases off southern New England. The pulls are compared
with each other and with a vessel-by-vessel review of the `r v_old` data
made for a study of fishing activity around these wind farms. It is written
for GFW staff, to report what changed between the two pipelines for a
small, heavily reviewed fleet, and where the `r v_new` labels and apparent
fishing hours still disagree with independent evidence.
:::

# Key findings {#sec-findings}

```{r findings-numbers, include=FALSE}
# Numbers quoted in the findings, gathered here so the prose stays in step
# with the data. Inline values never start a line: a number followed by a
# full stop at the start of a line would make Markdown begin a numbered list.
fp_status <- status_tab(fp_old); fn_status <- status_tab(fn_old)
st_n <- \(t, s) sum(t$mmsi[t$status == s])
fish_mmsi_old <- n_distinct(vp_old$MMSI[vp_old$`Vessel Type` == "FISHING"])
fish_mmsi_new <- n_distinct(vp_new$MMSI[vp_new$`Vessel Type` == "FISHING"])
grain_pct <- \(ds, g) grain_tab$pct_old_matched[grain_tab$dataset == ds & grepl(g, grain_tab$grain)]

# analysis-set hours by cohort gear class, old vs new
gr <- \(g, col) { x <- gear_ratio[gear_ratio$cohort_gear == g, ]
  pct_change(sum(x[[col]][x$version == v_old]), sum(x[[col]][x$version == v_new])) }
rs <- \(ds, g, s) ratio_stage$pct[ratio_stage$dataset == ds & ratio_stage$cohort_gear == g &
                                    ratio_stage$stage == s]

# AFE by year: the largest rise and fall
afe_year <- by_year |> filter(dataset == "AFE") |> select(year, version, hours) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = hours) |>
  mutate(pct = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]]))
yr_up <- slice_max(afe_year, pct, n = 1); yr_dn <- slice_min(afe_year, pct, n = 1)

# permitted vessels that left FISHING, split by whether the review covers them
lost_permit <- lost_fishing |> filter(!is.na(permit_group))
lost_permit_unrev <- lost_permit |> filter(is.na(reviewed_as))

# activity false positives by kind of window
act_op <- \(op, ver) sum(act$hours[act$Operation == op & act$version == ver])
# safety vessels' v5 AFE as a share of their v5 VP inside the same windows
act_share <- 100 * act_op("Safety", v_new) /
  sum(act_vp$hours[act_vp$Operation == "Safety" & act_vp$version == v_new])
act_slow <- speed_tab |> filter(set == act_set_label) |>
  summarise(pct = 100 * sum(.data[[v_new]][speed_kn %in% c("<2", "2-4")]) / sum(.data[[v_new]])) |> pull(pct)

# reviewed gear
gs <- \(g, ver, col) gear_score[[col]][gear_score$truth_gear == g & gear_score$version == ver]
n_gear <- \(g) sum(gt_$truth_gear == g)

# % change for one gear × stage × distance band (AFE)
rb <- \(g, s, b) ratio_band$pct[ratio_band$dataset == "AFE" & ratio_band$cohort_gear == g &
                                  ratio_band$stage == s & ratio_band$dist_band == b]
```

1. **AFE fell by `r p1(abs(tv("AFE", "hours", "pct")))` overall, and the
   change is not the same in every period.** AFE went from
   `r n0(tv("AFE", "hours", v_old))` to `r n0(tv("AFE", "hours", v_new))` h,
   and the number of vessels with any AFE fell from
   `r n0(tv("AFE", "mmsi", v_old))` to `r n0(tv("AFE", "mmsi", v_new))` MMSIs.
   By year, the change ranges from `r sp1(yr_dn$pct)` in `r yr_dn$year` to
   `r sp1(yr_up$pct)` in `r yr_up$year`. Mobile-gear AFE for the same
   vessels changed by `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 1"))` before
   offshore wind development (Stage 1), `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 2"))`
   in Stage 2 and `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 3"))` during construction
   (Stage 3). A change that differs by period biases any before–after
   comparison (@sec-bias).
2. **Total vessel presence (VP) hardly changed, but where the hours fall
   did.** VP hours changed by `r n0(tv("VP", "hours", "change"))` h, which is
   less than 0.1%. Matched by vessel and day, `r p1(grain_pct("VP", "Vessel-day"))`
   of v4 VP hours have a v5 counterpart. At the 0.01° cell level, only
   `r p1(grain_pct("VP", "^Record"))` do. The unmatched hours are scattered
   along each vessel's track, not shifted by one cell (@sec-recon).
3. **v5 types far fewer vessels as FISHING, and pole-and-line (for-hire)
   vessels mostly drop out.** The count of MMSIs typed FISHING went from
   `r n0(fish_mmsi_old)` to `r n0(fish_mmsi_new)`. Of the
   `r n0(nrow(lost_fishing))` that left FISHING, most are now PASSENGER, and
   `r n0(nrow(lost_permit))` hold a federal (GARFO) commercial or for-hire
   permit. Among the vessels this study counts as fishing, pole-and-line
   (for-hire) VP falls by `r p1(abs(gr("POLE_AND_LINE", "vp")))` and its AFE
   by `r p1(abs(gr("POLE_AND_LINE", "afe")))` (@sec-type).
4. **Non-fishing vessels labelled as fishing are largely fixed.** Of the
   `r n0(nrow(fp_old))` hulls that our review found were not fishing vessels
   but v4 typed FISHING, v5 corrects `r n0(st_n(fp_status, "corrected"))`.
   Most were yachts, sailing vessels and research vessels. The NOAA research
   trawler *Gloria Michelle* and the hopper dredge *Atchafalaya* are still
   typed FISHING (@sec-fp).
5. **Missed fishing vessels are not fixed.** Of the `r n0(nrow(fn_old))`
   confirmed fishing hulls that v4 typed as non-fishing (mostly PASSENGER or
   OTHER), v5 types only
   `r n0(st_n(fn_status, "corrected"))` as FISHING. It also newly mistypes
   `r n0(nrow(new_err))` reviewed fishing hulls that v4 had right
   (@sec-fn).
6. **Gear improves for mobile gear only.** Among `r n0(n_gear("MOBILE"))`
   reviewed mobile-gear vessels, v5's gear is correct for
   `r n0(gs("MOBILE", v_new, "mmsi_correct"))`, up from
   `r n0(gs("MOBILE", v_old, "mmsi_correct"))` in v4. Among
   `r n0(n_gear("FIXED"))` reviewed fixed-gear vessels it is correct for
   `r n0(gs("FIXED", v_new, "mmsi_correct"))` and wrong for
   `r n0(gs("FIXED", v_new, "mmsi_wrong"))`, which v5 gives a mobile or
   pole-and-line gear. Among
   `r n0(n_gear("POLE_AND_LINE"))` reviewed pole-and-line vessels it is
   correct for `r n0(gs("POLE_AND_LINE", v_new, "mmsi_correct"))` (@sec-gearval).
7. **AFE from fishing vessels chartered for offshore wind work barely
   changed.** Safety and guard vessels standing by construction log AFE for
   `r p1(act_share)` of the hours they are present in v5. Their AFE went from
   `r n0(act_op("Safety", v_old))` to `r n0(act_op("Safety", v_new))` h
   (`r sp1(pct_change(act_op("Safety", v_old), act_op("Safety", v_new)))`),
   and `r p1(act_slow)` of the v5 hours are on days with a mean speed under
   4 kn. AFE on dated survey trips fell further, by
   `r p1(abs(pct_change(act_op("Survey", v_old), act_op("Survey", v_new))))`
   (@sec-activity).
8. **Fixed-gear AFE fell by `r p1(abs(gr("FIXED", "afe")))`, while their VP
   changed by `r sp1(gr("FIXED", "vp"))`.** These are reviewed and
   GFW-labelled lobster, crab and gillnet vessels. The fall fits GFW's own
   list of v5 false negatives. `r n0(nrow(fixed_lost))` reviewed fixed-gear
   hulls had AFE in v4 and have none in v5 (@sec-fixed).

# Data and methods {#sec-methods}

## The two pulls

```{r pull-table}
bind_rows(pull_old, pull_new) |>
  transmute(Pipeline = pipeline, `Pull date` = pull_date,
            `Query window` = paste(query_start, "to", query_end, "(end excluded)"),
            `VP dataset` = vp_dataset, `AFE dataset` = afe_dataset,
            `VP rows (raw)` = as.integer(vp_rows), `AFE rows (raw)` = as.integer(afe_rows)) |>
  kt()
```

- **Same request in both.** Both pulls use the same AOI polygon and gfwr
  `r pull_new$gfwr_version` 4Wings report parameters: 0.01° cells
  (`spatial_resolution = HIGH`), daily, grouped by `VESSEL_ID`, with the
  vessel's identity fields. Only the dataset version differs.
- **How each version was requested.** The `r v_old` pull requested
  `:latest` on `r pull_old$pull_date`, which then resolved to v4. v4 was
  still updated daily until it was frozen as `:v4.0` on 2026-10-21. A spot
  check of June 2024 against `:v4.0` matched record for record. The
  `r v_new` pull named `:v5.0` explicitly.
- **Analysis window.** Everything below covers **`r analysis_start` to
  `r analysis_end`**, the period the study analyses. It is split into three
  development stages, and the stages appear wherever a change could bias the
  study:

```{r stages}
dev_stages |> transmute(Stage = stage, Start = start, End = end, Months = months,
                        Description = description) |> kt()
```

- **Joining the two versions.** GFW's `vesselId` is stable between v4 and v5,
  so records are joined on **Vessel ID × cell × day**. The cell is matched on
  its lattice index, not on the Lat/Lon text, because the two pulls format
  coordinates differently: v4 gives `41.25` and v5 gives `41.250000`.

## Reference labels from the hand review

GFW publishes no precision or recall for its vessel classes, so both versions
are scored against the same independent reference: this study's review of
`r n0(nrow(ht))` vessels (MMSIs) that have records in the window. Each was
checked against one or more of the following sources:

- **MarineTraffic** vessel particulars and photographs.
- **USCG PSIX** (Port State Information Exchange) vessel documentation: service
  type, length and owner.
- **NOAA GARFO** (Greater Atlantic Regional Fisheries Office) federal permit
  lists, 2016–2026. These were matched by vessel name, hull ID and length, and
  give the permit category (commercial, for-hire, open-access) and the gear
  each permit allows.
- **Ørsted records** for the vessels it hired:
  - survey project and date data that Ørsted provided: trips by commercial
    fishing vessels, with daily departure and return dates;
  - safety, guard and scout vessels on the Ørsted–SSNA safety-vessel
    contract, several of them also named in Appendix A of the SFW
    protected-species observer and passive acoustic monitoring (PSO/PAM)
    report for 2024;
  - a behavioural screen for charter-like vessels, applying the same contract
    start (2021-05-01).
- **GFW's own identity and registry records**, including RFMO registries.

The reference has three levels:

| Level | Question | Reference | Count |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hull | Is this MMSI a fishing vessel? | Hull class from the review (fishing, non-fishing, gear buoy), plus vessels whose GFW label the reviewer checked and confirmed | `r n0(nrow(ht))` MMSIs |
| Gear | What gear does it fish? | Gear class from the review (MOBILE, FIXED, POLE_AND_LINE) | `r n0(nrow(gt_))` MMSIs |
| Activity | Was this fishing hull fishing on this day? | Dated windows of verified non-fishing work: survey trips, safety and guard charters | `r n0(n_distinct(cw$MMSI[cw$activity_excluded]))` MMSIs |

The gear classes group GFW gear codes:

- **MOBILE:** trawlers, dredges, purse seines, trollers and drifting longlines.
- **FIXED:** set gillnets, pots and traps, set longlines and generic fixed gear.
- **POLE_AND_LINE:** mostly the recreational for-hire fleet.
- **UNRESOLVED:** generic `FISHING`, `INCONCLUSIVE` or no gear.

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
## The reference favours v5

The vessels were reviewed because **v4** flagged them: screens for missed
fishing vessels, foreign-flag visits, gear buoys and charter-like behaviour,
all run on v4 labels. The reference is therefore rich in v4 errors, and it
says little about vessels v5 newly mislabels. @sec-type shows where those
are likely, and they have not yet been checked by hand.
:::

# Reconciliation: do the two pulls line up? {#sec-recon}

## Totals

```{r totals-table}
tot_wide |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, records = "Records", mmsi = "MMSIs",
                          vessel_ids = "Vessel IDs", cells = "Cells", hours = "Hours")) |>
  rename(Dataset = dataset, Measure = measure, Change = change, `% change` = pct) |>
  kt(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
```

```{r fig-year, fig.height=4.5}
#| fig-cap: "Hours per year in each version. VP (left) and AFE (right) have their own y-axis scales."
ggplot(by_year, aes(year, hours, colour = version)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ fct_relevel(dataset, "VP"), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_ver) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2016, 2026, 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hours", caption = "2026 runs to 31 August.") +
  theme_report
```

AFE by year, with the change from `r v_old` to `r v_new`:

```{r afe-year}
by_year |>
  filter(dataset == "AFE") |>
  select(year, version, hours) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = hours) |>
  mutate(`% change` = pct_change(.data[[v_old]], .data[[v_new]])) |>
  mutate(year = as.character(year)) |>   # no thousands separator in years
  rename(Year = year) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

## How much of each version's hours the other one shares

```{r grain-table}
grain_tab |>
  transmute(Dataset = dataset, Grain = grain,
            !!paste("Keys,", v_old) := keys_old, !!paste("Keys,", v_new) := keys_new,
            !!paste0("% of ", v_old, " hours on a shared key") := pct_old_matched,
            !!paste0("% of ", v_new, " hours on a shared key") := pct_new_matched,
            !!paste0("% of ", v_old, " hours with identical hours") := pct_old_same) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

The same vessel is present on the same days in both versions. Matched by
vessel and day, `r p1(grain_tab$pct_old_matched[grain_tab$dataset == "VP" & grepl("Vessel-day", grain_tab$grain)])`
of `r v_old` VP hours are matched. Within a vessel-day, though, the 0.01°
cells that receive the hours differ.
`r p1(100 - grain_tab$pct_old_matched[grain_tab$dataset == "VP" & grepl("^Record", grain_tab$grain)])`
of `r v_old` VP hours fall in a cell where `r v_new` has no record for that
vessel on that day. Of those unmatched `r v_old` records,
`r p1(pct_rec_with_partner)` have an unmatched `r v_new` record for the same
vessel and day. The distances between them:

```{r offset-table}
offset_tab |>
  rename(`Cells apart (nearest unmatched v5 record, same vessel-day)` = cells_apart,
         Records = n, `%` = pct) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

A shift of the output grid would put nearly all of these at one cell, in
one direction. Instead they are spread out and point every way. That fits a
change in which positions represent the vessel in each hour, such as a
different thinning or segmentation of the track. **Question for GFW:** is
this expected, and has the method for assigning presence hours to cells
changed in v5?

Cell totals over the whole window still agree closely (Pearson r =
`r sprintf("%.3f", cell_r["VP"])` for VP and `r sprintf("%.3f", cell_r["AFE"])`
for AFE). Totals over many vessels and days are robust to the change.
Results for a single vessel-day are not.

# Vessel type relabelling {#sec-type}

## Vessel types in each version

```{r type-sets}
type_sets |>
  arrange(desc(.data[[paste0("vp_hours_", v_old)]] + .data[[paste0("vp_hours_", v_new)]])) |>
  mutate(type = coalesce(type, "(blank)")) |>
  rename(`Vessel type` = type) |>
  rename_with(\(n) sub("^mmsi_", "MMSIs ", sub("^vp_hours_", "VP h ", n))) |>
  kt()
```

v5 renames `OTHER` to `OTHER_NON_FISHING` and adds `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`
(`r n0(nrow(insuff))` MMSIs here). `DISCREPANCY`, which v5 removes, did not
occur in this area in v4. MMSIs typed FISHING fall by a third, while
PASSENGER and CARGO both gain vessels and hours.

## Transitions

These are the largest type changes per MMSI. Each MMSI takes its most
frequent label in each version. Hours are `r v_old` hours.

```{r type-transitions}
type_tr |>
  filter(from != to) |>
  slice_max(vp_hours, n = 20) |>
  transmute(!!paste(v_old, "type") := from, !!paste(v_new, "type") := to, MMSIs = mmsi,
            `VP hours (v4)` = vp_hours, `AFE hours (v4)` = afe_hours) |>
  kt()
```

`r csv_link(type_tr, "type_transitions.csv", "Every type transition")`

## Fishing ↔ non-fishing flips

```{r flips}
flip_tab |>
  rename(Direction = direction, `Other type` = type_new, MMSIs = mmsi,
         `VP h (v4)` = vp_old, `AFE h (v4)` = afe_old,
         `VP h (v5)` = vp_new, `AFE h (v5)` = afe_new,
         `With GARFO permit` = with_garfo_permit) |>
  kt()
```

Most of the vessels leaving FISHING were seen here only briefly: the median
is `r n0(median(lost_fishing$vp_old))` VP hours. In v4 they mostly carried a
weak gear label: POLE_AND_LINE for
`r n0(sum(lost_fishing$gear_old %in% "POLE_AND_LINE"))`, generic FISHING for
`r n0(sum(lost_fishing$gear_old %in% "FISHING"))` and INCONCLUSIVE for
`r n0(sum(lost_fishing$gear_old %in% "INCONCLUSIVE"))`. v5 now types most of
them PASSENGER. Without a federal permit, many are probably recreational
boats, so many of these flips may be corrections. However,
`r n0(nrow(lost_permit))` of these vessels hold a GARFO commercial or
for-hire fishing permit. They had `r n0(sum(lost_permit$afe_old))` AFE hours
in v4 and have `r n0(sum(lost_permit$afe_new))` in v5, because v5 computes no
AFE for vessels it does not type as fishing.

The hand review already covers `r n0(sum(!is.na(lost_permit$reviewed_as)))`
of the permitted vessels. All of them are fishing hulls, several on survey
or safety charters (@sec-fn). The other `r n0(nrow(lost_permit_unrev))` have
not been reviewed. Until they are, they are **candidate** false negatives.
The full list gives each vessel's labels, permit group, review status and
hours in both versions:

`r csv_link(lost_fishing, "fishing_to_nonfishing.csv", "Vessels typed FISHING in v4 and not in v5")`

```{r lost-top}
lost_fishing |>
  filter(!is.na(permit_group)) |>
  slice_max(afe_old + vp_old / 100, n = 25) |>
  transmute(MMSI, Name = Vessel_Name, `v4 type/gear` = paste(type_old, gear_old, sep = " / "),
            `v5 type` = type_new, `GARFO permit` = permit_group,
            Reviewed = coalesce(reviewed_as, "not reviewed"), Charter = coalesce(charter, ""),
            `VP h v4` = vp_old, `AFE h v4` = afe_old, `AFE h v5` = afe_new) |>
  kt(caption = "The 25 permitted vessels with the most v4 AFE (ties broken by VP)")
```

## INSUFFICIENT_DATA

```{r insuff}
insuff_tab |>
  rename(`v4 type` = type_old, MMSIs = mmsi, `VP h (v5)` = vp_new, `AFE h (v4)` = afe_old) |>
  kt()
```

`INSUFFICIENT_DATA` covers vessels with 500 or fewer positions a year, so it
carries little VP. It also takes in
`r n0(sum(fn_old$type_new %in% "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"))` vessels this study
confirmed as fishing hulls (@sec-fn).

# Validation against the hand review {#sec-validation}

## Hull-level scores in each version

TP is a fishing hull typed FISHING. FP is a non-fishing hull or gear buoy
typed FISHING. FN is a fishing hull typed as non-fishing. TN is a
non-fishing hull typed as non-fishing. Each row counts reviewed MMSIs with
records in that version.

```{r confusion}
confusion |>
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, c("TP", "FP", "FN", "TN"))) |>
  arrange(version, outcome) |>
  rename(Version = version, Outcome = outcome, MMSIs = mmsi,
         `VP hours` = vp_hours, `AFE hours` = afe_hours) |>
  kt()
rates |>
  transmute(Version = version, `Precision (%)` = precision, `Recall (%)` = recall) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

These rates hold only for the reviewed set (see the warning in
@sec-methods). They do **not** estimate GFW's accuracy across the AOI.

## False positives: non-fishing vessels typed FISHING in v4 {#sec-fp}

```{r fp-status}
status_tab(fp_old) |> rename_status() |> kt()
```

```{r fp-list}
fp_old |>
  transmute(MMSI, Name = Vessel_Name, `Reviewed as` = truth_hull,
            `v4 type/gear` = paste(type_old, gear_old, sep = " / "),
            `v5 type/gear` = paste(type_new, gear_new, sep = " / "),
            `Status` = status, `VP h v4` = vp_old, `VP h v5` = vp_new,
            `AFE h v4` = afe_old, `AFE h v5` = afe_new,
            Source = Identified_By, Evidence = evidence_ref) |>

```

`r csv_link(fp_old, "hull_false_positives_v4.csv")`

## False negatives: fishing vessels v4 typed as non-fishing {#sec-fn}

```{r fn-status}
status_tab(fn_old) |> rename_status() |> kt()
fn_old |>
  count(`v4 type` = type_old, `v5 type` = coalesce(type_new, "(absent)"), name = "MMSIs", sort = TRUE) |>
  kt()
```

Most of these hulls were confirmed as fishing vessels by name, hull ID and
length matches to GARFO commercial or for-hire permits, then checked in
MarineTraffic and USCG PSIX. The three with the most VP (FLEET QUEEN,
TRIUNFO and SEA WIND) are fishing hulls on Ørsted safety charters, so their
work there is not fishing (@sec-activity). The rest fish, and GFW types them
PASSENGER, OTHER or INSUFFICIENT_DATA. These are the 50 with the most v4 VP
hours:

```{r fn-list}
fn_old |>
  slice_max(vp_old, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  transmute(MMSI, Name = Vessel_Name,
            `v4 type` = type_old, `v5 type/gear` = paste(type_new, gear_new, sep = " / "),
            Status = status, `VP h v4` = vp_old, `VP h v5` = vp_new,
            Source = Identified_By, Evidence = evidence_ref) |>
  kt()
```

`r csv_link(fn_old, "hull_false_negatives_v4.csv", "All false negatives in v4, with their v5 labels")`

## New errors in v5 among reviewed vessels

These are vessels whose `r v_old` label the review confirmed, and which
`r v_new` now labels wrongly. The `OTHER_NON_FISHING` vessels are fishing
hulls on survey or safety charters. Their v5 type describes their charter
work, not the hull. Because GFW types the whole vessel and not each day, any
fishing these vessels do outside their charters gets no AFE in v5. The
PASSENGER vessels are for-hire boats that the review confirmed as fishing.

```{r new-errors}
if (nrow(new_err) == 0) asis_output("None.") else
  new_err |>
    transmute(MMSI, Name = Vessel_Name, `Reviewed as` = truth_hull,
              `v4 type/gear` = paste(type_old, gear_old, sep = " / "),
              `v5 type/gear` = paste(type_new, gear_new, sep = " / "),
              `v5 outcome` = out_new, `VP h v4` = vp_old, `VP h v5` = vp_new,
              `AFE h v4` = afe_old, `AFE h v5` = afe_new, Source = Identified_By) |>
    kt()
```

```{r gear-score}
gear_score |>

  rename_with(\(n) str_to_sentence(sub("mmsi_", "", n)), starts_with("mmsi_")) |>
  kt()
```

How each reviewed vessel's gear outcome moved from `r v_old` to `r v_new`:

```{r gear-move}
gear_move |>

```

```{r gear-fixed-list}
gt_ |>

            `v4` = gout_old, `v5` = gout_new,
```

## Activity false positives: AFE during survey trips and safety charters {#sec-activity}

Several commercial fishing vessels were hired for offshore wind work after
2020. During that work the hull is a fishing vessel, but it is not fishing.

- **Survey trips** are Ørsted's fisheries monitoring surveys (trawl,
  ventless trap and others). Each trip is dated day by day in the survey
  project and date data Ørsted provided, so AFE on those days is a confirmed activity false
  positive. Some survey gear, such as trawl survey tows, is mechanically
  fishing. Even so, it is survey work and not commercial effort.
- **Safety and guard duty** means escorting construction vessels or
  standing by them. The vessels are those on the Ørsted–SSNA safety-vessel
  contract, many of them also named in Appendix A of the SFW PSO/PAM report
  for 2024. A few vessels were added from this study's behavioural screen for
  charter-like activity, such as long days spent mostly inside the leases.
  The windows are **contract periods, not dated trips**. Most start at
  Stage 2 (2020-10-01) or at the Ørsted–SSNA safety-vessel contract
  (2021-05-01), and PROVIDER's starts on 2020-06-18. All are open-ended. A
  contracted vessel may still fish on some days inside its window, so these
  hours are an upper bound on activity false positives. The speed table
  below suggests that most of them are standby.

```{r activity-table}
act_tab |>
  arrange(Operation, `Development Stage`) |>
  rename(Stage = `Development Stage`,
         !!paste("AFE h", v_old) := all_of(v_old), !!paste("AFE h", v_new) := all_of(v_new),
         `VP h (v5)` = vp_hours_new, `% change` = pct) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

By vessel, with the source of each window:

```{r activity-vessels}
act_vessel |>
  rename(Name = Vessel_Name, `v4 type` = type_old, `v5 type` = type_new, Source = Identified_By) |>
  rename_with(\(n) sub("^afe_", "AFE h ", sub("^vp_", "VP h ", n))) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

`r csv_link(act_vessel, "activity_false_positives.csv")`

### Speed on days with AFE (v5 only)

v5 adds a presence `speed` field. Each AFE record gets the vessel's
hours-weighted mean speed on that day, from its v5 VP records. Towing and
hauling are normally below about 4–5 kn. Vessels holding station or
drifting on guard duty are below 2 kn. In this table, the
`r act_set_label` rows are the activity false positives, and the other rows
are everything else in the analysis set.

In v5, AFE on fishing vessels' ordinary days drops sharply above 6 kn,
which fits GFW's removal of transit false positives. During charter work,
however, `r p1(act_slow)` of v5 AFE is below 4 kn, and most of that is
below 2 kn. Slow standby near a construction site still reads as fishing.

```{r speed-table}
speed_tab |>
  rename(Set = set, `Vessel-day mean speed (kn)` = speed_kn,
         !!paste("AFE h", v_old) := all_of(v_old), !!paste("AFE h", v_new) := all_of(v_new),
         `% change` = pct) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

## Fishing false negatives: reviewed fixed-gear vessels {#sec-fixed}

GFW lists fixed gear, pots and traps, set gillnets and set longlines among
v5's known false negatives. The fixed-gear fleet here is mainly lobster and
Jonah crab pot boats and gillnetters out of Rhode Island and Massachusetts.
The table gives AFE and VP for the analysis set of each version (our review
applied to that version's labels), with gear held at the reviewed class.
Records in survey and safety-charter windows are left out. VP depends on
no fishing model, so it is the yardstick. Gear is held at each vessel's
reviewed class: where a vessel was reviewed, its reviewed gear, otherwise
GFW's v4 gear class. That way a vessel's hours stay in the same row in both
versions.

The pole-and-line row is mostly a label effect. v5 types most of the
for-hire fleet PASSENGER (@sec-type), so those vessels leave the fishing set
and their VP goes with them.

```{r gear-ratio}
gear_ratio |>
  arrange(cohort_gear, version) |>
  transmute(`Gear class` = cohort_gear, Version = version, `AFE h` = afe,
            `MMSIs with AFE` = afe_mmsi, `VP h` = vp, `MMSIs with VP` = vp_mmsi,
            `AFE h per 100 VP h` = afe_per_100_vp) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

```{r fig-fixed-month, fig.height=4}
#| fig-cap: "AFE by month of year for reviewed fixed-gear vessels, outside verified non-fishing windows."
ggplot(fixed_month, aes(month, afe, colour = version, group = version)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_ver) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AFE hours (2016–2026, summed)") +
  theme_report
```

Reviewed fixed-gear vessels with `r v_old` AFE, ordered by `r v_old` AFE:

```{r fixed-list}
fixed_vessel |>
  filter(.data[[paste0("afe_", v_old)]] > 0 | .data[[paste0("afe_", v_new)]] > 0) |>
  rename(Name = Vessel_Name, `v4 type` = type_old, `v5 type` = type_new,
         `v4 gear` = gear_old, `v5 gear` = gear_new, Basis = basis) |>
  rename_with(\(n) sub("^afe_", "AFE h ", sub("^vp_", "VP h ", n))) |>
  kt(digits = 1)
```

`r csv_link(fixed_vessel, "fixed_gear_vessels.csv")`

# Is the change uniform in time and space? {#sec-bias}

The study compares effort before, during and after construction, at
distances from the leases (a Before–After–Gradient design). A change
between versions that is the same everywhere cancels out of those
contrasts. A change that differs by stage or by distance does not. These
tables give the `r v_new` vs `r v_old` % change in hours for the analysis
set, with gear held at the cohort class.

```{r ratio-stage}
ratio_stage |>
  select(dataset, cohort_gear, stage, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = pct) |>
  arrange(desc(dataset), cohort_gear) |>
  rename(Dataset = dataset, Gear = cohort_gear) |>
  kt(digits = 1, caption = "% change in hours, v5 vs v4, by stage")
```

VP barely moves for mobile and fixed gear, as it should when no fishing
model is involved. AFE does move, and by different amounts in each stage:

- **Mobile-gear AFE** changes by `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 1"))`,
  `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 2"))` and
  `r sp1(rs("AFE", "MOBILE", "Stage 3"))` in Stages 1 to 3, so it rises most
  in the earliest years. AIS coverage of this inshore fleet was sparser then,
  and v5 drops the minimum-position requirement. A plausible explanation is
  that v5 now classifies positions that v4 left null. GFW may be able to
  confirm this.
- **Fixed-gear AFE** falls in every stage: by
  `r p1(abs(rs("AFE", "FIXED", "Stage 1")))`,
  `r p1(abs(rs("AFE", "FIXED", "Stage 2")))` and
  `r p1(abs(rs("AFE", "FIXED", "Stage 3")))` in Stages 1 to 3.

For a before–after design, a change that differs by stage is not neutral.
Compared with v4, v5 makes mobile-gear effort after construction began look
lower relative to the baseline, even though the fleet did nothing different.

```{r fig-band, fig.height=6}
#| fig-cap: "% change in AFE hours (v5 vs v4) by distance band from the nearest lease and stage. Bands with fewer than 20 v4 AFE hours are omitted."
ratio_band |>
  filter(dataset == "AFE", .data[[v_old]] >= 20) |>
  mutate(dist_band = factor(dist_band, c("inside", "0-2", "2-4", "4-8", "8-15"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(dist_band, pct, colour = stage, group = stage)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#8a8984", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort_gear) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Stage 1" = "#2a78d6", "Stage 2" = "#eb6834", "Stage 3" = "#1baf7a")) +
  labs(x = "Distance band (km from nearest lease)", y = "% change in AFE hours") +
  theme_report
```

The change also varies with distance from the leases. In Stage 1,
mobile-gear AFE rises by `r sp1(rb("MOBILE", "Stage 1", "inside"))` inside
the leases but by `r sp1(rb("MOBILE", "Stage 1", "2-4"))` at 2–4 km. A
version change that differs inside and outside the leases enters the
Before–After–Gradient contrast directly.

`r csv_link(ratio_band, "ratio_stage_band.csv", "% change by dataset, gear, stage and distance band")`

```{r fig-map, fig.height=7}
#| fig-cap: "Change in AFE hours per 0.01° cell (v5 − v4), analysis set, all gears, 2016–2026. Red: fewer hours in v5. The colour scale is capped at the 98th percentile of the absolute change. Outlines: SFW, RWF and SRW lease areas."
cap <- quantile(abs(cell_afe$diff), 0.98)
leases_ll <- st_transform(leases, 4326)
ggplot(cell_afe) +
  geom_tile(aes(lon, lat, fill = pmax(pmin(diff, cap), -cap)), width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  geom_sf(data = leases_ll, fill = NA, colour = "#0b0b0b", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = col_loss, mid = col_mid, high = col_gain, midpoint = 0,
                       limits = c(-cap, cap), name = "AFE h, v5 − v4") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_report + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text())
```

Most of the cells that lose hours are in the north of the area, toward
Rhode Island Sound and the shallower inshore grounds. Most of the cells
that gain hours are in the southwest. That pattern fits GFW's note that v5
misses shallow, near-shore fishing.

# Caveats {#sec-caveats}

- **The reference favours v5.** It was built by reviewing v4's suspected
  errors, so v4's error rates are overstated relative to v5's. Vessels v5
  newly mislabels, such as the permitted vessels that left FISHING
  (@sec-type), are candidates, not confirmed errors.
- **The v4 data are a snapshot.** They were taken from `:latest` on
  `r pull_old$pull_date`, before v4 was frozen. Labels for six MMSIs differed
  in frozen `:v4.0` on the June 2024 spot check. Hours matched.
- **Safety-charter windows are contract periods.** They are open-ended from
  each contract's start, so their AFE is an upper bound on activity false
  positives (@sec-activity). Survey trips are dated day by day.
- **Hours are as GFW serves them.** Only the review's classifications are
  applied, and no hours are adjusted.
- **MMSI is the counting unit.** A shared or reused MMSI can blend two hulls.
  The review checked for this where it could (by length, name and
  transmission dates).
- **Activity windows are complete only for known contracts.** Survey dates
  cover Ørsted's survey programme through `r survey_dates_through`. Safety
  windows are open-ended from the contract start. Other operators'
  charters are not covered.

# Questions for Global Fishing Watch {#sec-questions}

1. **Presence by cell.** Has the way v5 assigns presence hours to 0.01° cells
   changed (thinning, segmentation)? Within the same vessel-days, the cells
   that receive the hours differ for
   `r p1(100 - grain_tab$pct_old_matched[grain_tab$dataset == "VP" & grepl("^Record", grain_tab$grain)])`
   of v4 VP hours (@sec-recon).
2. **Permitted fishing vessels typed as non-fishing.** Can vessels that v5 types
   PASSENGER or INSUFFICIENT_DATA be flagged? For example, through the
   registry match or through `atomicClassSc` (@sec-type, @sec-fn).
3. **Fixed gear.** Is there a planned fix or a recommended correction for
   fixed-gear apparent fishing (pots, gillnets) in near-shore,
   shallow-water fleets (@sec-fixed)?
4. **Charter and survey work by fishing vessels.** Would dated lists of
   offshore wind survey and guard work help as training or evaluation data
   for activity false positives (@sec-activity)?

# Reproducibility {#sec-repro}

```{r repro}
commit <- tryCatch(system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE), error = \(e) NA_character_)
tibble(Item = c("Repository commit", "Rendered", "R", "gfwr"),
       Value = c(commit, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"), R.version.string,
                 pull_new$gfwr_version)) |>
  kt()
```

Raw 4Wings extracts: `data/raw/gfw/{v4,v5}/`. Review inputs:
`references/vessel_decisions.csv`, `vessel_gear.csv`, `vessel_removals.csv`,
`orsted_fv_survey_dates_aug2026.csv`, `vessel_crosswalk_v4.csv` and
`vessel_permit_groups_v4.csv`. Code: `r/compare_helpers.R` and this file.
Every table in this report is also written to
`reports/pipeline_compare/tables/`. GFW data are CC BY-SA 4.0.
